cards.title: Proceed down the Intracoastal
mapFocus: (KTFP) Ingleside Regional Airport/North Arrivals/9 Mile Point
instructions: State your intentions to Corpus Approach
Proceed down the Intracoastal at 1,500' MSL · 240 KIAS
Once clear of Aransas County Airport, proceed direct to the initial or downwind
cards.detail: Transitions to and from Ingleside conflict with multiple VFR routes and IFR approaches. Be alert for IFR traffic at 1,600' MSL and stay below 3,000' MSL unless in contact with Corpus Approach.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 55–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 86, 89.
